metadata.question: Does the surface water extent along the Lower Mississippi River (e.g., Mississippi, Louisiana) increase in February 2, 2020 compared to December 4, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lower Mississippi River region (Mississippi, Louisiana states) - Time periods: December 4, 2019 vs February 2, 2020 - Data: Use JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1/2 for water detection - Best option: Sentinel-1 SAR (works in all weather) or Sentinel-2 with water indices 2. Masking strategy: - For water detection, I'll use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) from Sentinel-2 - Or use Sentinel-1 VV polarization for water (low backscatter = water) - Cloud masking needed for Sentinel-2 3. Logic to distinguish outcomes: - Valid result: Calculate water area for both dates and compare - C1: If no images found for either date - C2: If valid pixels = 0 after processing - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If water extent increased (Feb > Dec) - B: If water extent decreased or stayed same (Feb <= Dec) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define region: Lower Mississippi River (Mississippi and Louisiana) const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-92.5, 29.0, -89.0, 33.0]); // 2. Date ranges (±7 days for image availability) const date1Start = '2019-11-27'; const date1End = '2019-12-11'; const date2Start = '2020-01-26'; const date2End = '2020-02-09'; // 3. Load Sentinel-1 SAR data (better for water detection, cloud-independent) let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Dec 2019 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Feb 2020 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Insufficient data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Create median composites and detect water (VV < -15 dB typically indicates water) const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); const waterThreshold = -15; const water1 = img1.lt(waterThreshold); const water2 = img2.lt(waterThreshold); // 5. Calculate water area in square meters const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const area1Result = water1.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2Result = water2.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // 6. Check pixel counts const count1Result = water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count1 = count1Result.get('VV').getInfo(); if (count1 === 0 || count1 === null) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } const area1 = area1Result.get('VV').getInfo(); const area2 = area2Result.get('VV').getInfo(); if (area1 === null || area2 === null || isNaN(area1) || isNaN(area2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } const area1_km2 = area1 / 1e6; const area2_km2 = area2 / 1e6; const change = area2_km2 - area1_km2; const percentChange = ((change / area1_km2) * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Dec 2019 Water: ${area1_km2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Feb 2020 Water: ${area2_km2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Change: ${change.toFixed(2)} km² (${percentChange}%)`); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); if (area2 > area1) { console.log("Water extent INCREASED in February 2020."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Water extent DID NOT increase in February 2020."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
